text:
sara_support: Customer (ACME) opened an escalation — they say answers are adding more ellipses and trailing fragments after the recent model bump. Examples attached. Customer says this started right after the v10 rollout. Wants us to investigate, potentially a regression.

james_se: Can you paste the before/after pair and the request ids? Also which model exactly was rolled to prod (full name + hash) and the time?

sara_support: Pasting samples they sent (redacted ids):
```
BEFORE (model: redwood-infer-v9.1, req: r-1738-xx, ts: 3066880000)
User: "How should I structure a status update for stakeholders?"
Assistant: "Start with a one-line summary of progress, then list top blockers with owner and ETA. Use bullet points for metrics: 
- Progress: shipped X feature (owner: @dev)
- Blockers: API rate limit, ETA 3 days
Finish with clear next steps and ask for any required decisions.
Example: 
Summary: We completed the data pipeline PR and are on track for release. Blockers: infra quota (tracking ticket). Next steps: schedule verification tests."

AFTER (model: redwood-infer-v10.0, req: r-1849-yy, ts: 3067890100)
User: "How should I structure a status update for stakeholders?"
Assistant: "Short summary. Bullets: progress. Blockers: who, ETA... Next steps. Ask if anything else is needed..."
```
They highlighted the extra "..." tokens and the loss of a short concrete example that used to be present. They also gave another pair where clarifying question was omitted in the new response.

mike_oncall: ops_bot shows v10 rollout completed at 3067890000. @james_se any chance a system-prompt or decoding param changed in the rollout? temp/top_p? :thinking:

ops_bot: model-deploy: redwood-infer-v10.0 rolled to production (all regions) at 3067890000 by ci/cd (deploy-413).

james_se: I want to know if decoding defaults changed (e.g., stop sequences, eos handling, penalize_repeat, or default temperature). Also need the exact system message used for v9.1 vs v10.0 for the hosted catalog entry. If we can repro locally, we should run a quick A/B with the old model for that org.

sara_support: Customer repro steps: simple single-shot prompt (no prior convo), max_tokens:150, temperature:0.2, stream:false. Locale en-US. They did not use any stop sequences. They tested ~30 prompts and saw this pattern ~70% of the time after v10.

mike_oncall: Mitigation path: can we pin ACME org to v9.1 as a temporary rollback while we investigate? If so, request org id and I'll open the canary rollback. Also collect request traces for r-1849-yy and one more sample.

sara_support: Org id provided privately to ops. Attached two request ids and full traces in the internal ticket. Quick note: customer is sensitive to tone changes; they flagged this when an internal workflow's generated email read oddly.

james_se: From quick glance at the sample, v10 tends to favor shorter utterances and emits more ellipses as a stylistic token — could be a change in tokenizer handling or pre/post-processing of trailing punctuation. Action items:
- Mike: pin org to v9.1 (canary) and confirm.
- Ops: fetch runtime config diff between v9.1 and v10.0 (decoding params + system prompt).
- Support (sara): ask customer for one more repro with minimal prompt and attach exact raw request JSON.

mike_oncall: Pinning request accepted, will toggle canary for org at 3067891200 and confirm when live. Will also run a quick diff on the model configs.

sara_support: Acknowledged. I'll request the raw JSON and sample logs from the customer and update the ticket once they reply. Thanks all :thumbsup:

james_se: If we can reproduce, I'll run a quick decode ablation (disable punctuation trimming, enforce min_length, test with deterministic sampling) and post results here. Also will add a quick note to model-onboarding to watch for stylistic shifts when merging tokenizer changes.

sara_support: Customer replied with raw JSON; attaching in the ticket. They appreciate the quick pivot and would like a follow-up once we confirm the rollback.

mike_oncall: Rollback pinned at 3067891250 for ACME org. Monitoring logs for any anomalies now.

sara_support: Closing loop with customer now, will paste their reply once they confirm behaviour normalized.

james_se: Good, keep me posted. If rollback doesn't remove the ellipses, escalate to infra/model-release team — could be a surfaced pre/post hook.

sara_support: Will do. End of thread.
